# Wandering Italy

> > Comprehensive travel guide to Italy covering destinations, weather, transportation, history, and authentic Italian food culture across regions from Tuscany and Rome to Sicily and Sardinia.

Wandering Italy provides detailed travel planning resources for exploring Italy's regions, cities, and cultural sites. The site features destination guides, climate data, transportation routes, historical attractions, and insights into Italian cuisine and traditions to help travelers experience authentic Italy.

## Key Topics

- Italy travel planning
- Tuscany
- Rome
- Sicily
- Palermo
- Sardinia
- Italian food culture
- Mediterranean climate
- Historic sites and medieval towers
- Vatican Museums
- Regional maps and guides
- Transportation routes
- Best time to visit Italy
- Authentic Italian experiences

## Regional Maps and Destination Guides

- [Sardinia Map and Travel Guide](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/maps/sardinia.html): Sardinia regional map with nuraghi sites and travel guide
- [Trentino Alto Adige Map and Tourist Guide](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/maps/trentino-alto-adige-map.html): Regional map and guide to Trentino Alto Adige/South Tyrol attractions
- [Bassano del Grappa Map and Guide](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/places/bassano-del-grappa-map.htm): Bassano del Grappa, Veneto: map with Ponte degli Alpini and attractions
- [Aventine Hill Guide, Rome](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/places/aventine-hill.html): Rome's Aventine Hill: Knights of Malta keyhole and ancient basilicas
- [Portus - Rome's Imperial Port](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/places/portus.html): Ancient Roman port Portus near Fiumicino Airport and Ostia Antica

## Weather and Climate Planning

- [Rome Weather & Historic Climate Charts](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/weather/rome-italy-weather.htm): Rome weather data, climate charts, and seasonal travel planning info
- [Palermo Weather & Historic Climate Charts](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/weather/palermo-weather-climate.html): Palermo, Sicily weather data and climate charts for travel planning

## History and Cultural Attractions

- [Where to See Medieval Towers in Italy](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/history/italian-medieval-towers.html): Guide to Italy's medieval towers including San Gimignano highlights
- [Vatican Museum Tickets and Tours in Rome](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/vatican-museums-tickets.html): Vatican Museums tickets, skip-the-line tours, and Sistine Chapel access

## Transportation and Logistics

- [How to Get from Venice to Greece](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/transportation/venice-to-athens.html): Transportation guide: Venice to Athens via ferry, flight, and overland

## Italian Food and Dining Culture

- [How to Order Good Food in Italy](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/a/good-food-italy.htm): Italian restaurant ordering tips and dining etiquette guide
- [Italian Olive Oil](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/links/italian-olive-oil.htm): Artisan olive oil guide with harvest experiences in Tuscany

## Travel Stories and Experiences

- [San Leo: Doing Tourism Right](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/blog/article/990/san-leo): San Leo, Emilia Romagna: medieval fortress and Romanesque churches
- [Ballooning Italy](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/blog/article/1087/ballooning-italy): Hot air ballooning over Tuscany's Chianti vineyards and festivals
- [The Introverted Traveler](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/blog/article/1226/the-introverted-traveler): Solo travel and cultural immersion tips for introverted travelers
- [Renting or Leasing a Car on Vacation](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/blog/article/392/renting-or-leasing-a-car-on-vacation): European car rental vs. buyback lease comparison for long stays
- [Verona's Casa di Giulietta - Notes on Breast and Other Rubbing](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/blog/article/545/verona-s-casa-di-giulietta-notes-on-breast-and-other-rubbing): Casa di Giulietta in Verona: Juliet statue and tourist traditions

## Optional

- [Italian Garlic](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/blog/article/1230/garlic): Aglio Rosso di Nubia and Italian garlic varieties at Modena's market
- [Pots for the Gourmet Who Has Everything (Else)](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/blog/article/774/glirarium+gourmet+dormouse+pot): Roman glirarium for raising edible dormice at Castro dei Volsci museum
- [Montereggio - a Booktown in Italy](https://www.wanderingitaly.com/blog/article/548/montereggio-a-booktown-in-italy): Montereggio booktown in Lunigiana, Tuscany's historic book village
